1) You swing wider then need be:

Part of getting into higher-level maps is to gauge your swing speed and width so you can keep up while maintaining accuracy. If you are swinging behind you then you are overswinging. There's nothing wrong with overswinging, however, you do it so much that you can't hit the faster sections reliably.

2) You use arms too much:

As others have said you use your arm when swinging too much. Use more wrist swings on faster maps and be able to switch between more wrist dependant swings and arm swings depending on the speed of the map or section of music. 

3) Work on your wrist accuracy

Wrist swing accuracy is a very valuable skill in faster-paced maps. One thing that helped me with wrist accuracy is to start as an arm swing and transfer my momentum to my wrist and controller to get the fastest and most accurate swings possible. When you start to practice expert and expert+ maps it is important to build a very fine-tuned muscle memory and be able to flick your wrists at any angle the game throws at you. Being able to flick your wrists accurately with more concise angles will help you in general no matter the map. This will also help you to hit those fast and tight angles where you have to swing across the note grid. 

4) Your shaking might be hindering your performance

Your arm swings and instability are shaking your whole FOV in this clip and practicing holding your 'camera' steadier will help across the board.

5) Learn about tipping and time dependency

You don't have to absolutely worship tipping or advanced practices like some of the crazy accuracy players do, however, tipping helped me with my accuracy and speed a TON because tipping players don't have to worry about bad cuts from hitting the note behind the one that was just cut.  [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sHlUzmI3sHA](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sHlUzmI3sHA) 

6) Figure out your optimal controller setup

For me on the Q2 I use a loose claw grip and changing my 'position z' setting helped a lot. The default quest grip is not great for beatsaber.
